title: Microsoft’s New Internal AI Code: Why Your Control Matters More Than Theirs
description:
Microsoft’s New Internal AI Code: Why Your Control Matters More Than Theirs. Does Microsoft’s internal code of conduct represent a meaningful safeguard for human oversight or merely a PR shield to deflect from broader industry-wide regulatory pressure?

What we covered:
• Microsoft unveils draft AI code of conduct to keep systems under human control
• AP reports Trump dismissed AI risk warnings as a 'hoax' and attack on data centers
• AP reports Microsoft committed to sweeping AI privacy rules for students
• AP says AI-linked stocks fell after industry leaders called for slowing development
• AP reports the Gates Foundation pledged $1 billion to expand AI access while warning about inequality

One lead story. The other headlines are supporting evidence, complications, or counterexamples.

Listener question: Do you trust internal corporate codes of conduct to keep AI under human control, or do you only trust government-enforced regulations?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
